messages.author: Daniel Esposito
messages.text: Quick one: did anything change on the Unity video creatives (UNT-VID-01..03) around Jul 9? unity_video_retarget CPI more than halved and I'm trying to work out if it's creative-driven.

replies.author: Hana Kobayashi
replies.text: Nothing from our side. Those three have been live unchanged since June 2. No new uploads, no end-card changes.

replies.author: Lucas Ferreira
replies.text: Also if it were creative you'd expect one of the three to move, not all three at once.

replies.author: Daniel Esposito
replies.text: Yeah, all three moved together. OK, not creative. Thanks!
